# Interface: GenerationParams

Optional generation parameters forwarded to the OpenAI-compatible serving request body. Names match the serving API wire keys. Only keys that are set are sent — undefined values are omitted so the endpoint applies its own defaults. Ranges are not validated here; the serving endpoint validates.

## Properties[​](#properties "Direct link to Properties")

### frequency\_penalty?[​](#frequency_penalty "Direct link to frequency_penalty?")

```ts
optional frequency_penalty: number;

```

Penalize tokens by frequency.
